About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies. 

About the Role

Figure is hiring a Senior Financial Portfolio Analyst – Servicing to provide advanced financial analysis, portfolio performance monitoring, servicing cost modeling, compliance oversight, and forecasting for a servicing portfolio. This role supports cross-functional teams such as Servicing Operations, Capital Markets, Collections/Default, Investor Reporting, and Asset Management.

What You’ll Do

  • Servicing P&L Management — Maintain and enhance servicing profit-and-loss models, including revenue streams, ancillary fees, sub-servicing costs, advances, late fees, recoveries, and corporate allocations.
  • MSR Valuation Support — Support mortgage servicing rights (MSR) valuation by modeling discount rates, CPR/prepayment speeds, delinquency curves, and cost-to-service assumptions.
  • Portfolio Analytics — Build dashboards tracking static pool performance, delinquency migration, modification outcomes, foreclosure metrics, and collection effectiveness.
  • Revenue & Cost Forecasting — Forecast servicing revenue based on portfolio balance, runoff, payoffs, and interest-rate conditions; develop models for default expenses, foreclosure timelines, claim recoveries, and REO performance.
  • Risk & Compliance Monitoring — Provide financial performance analysis, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring for servicing portfolios.
  • Escrow & Advance Modeling — Model escrow balances, interest earnings, advance recoverability, and servicing cost allocations by investor.
  • Operational & Strategic Support — Contribute financial insights to operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Reporting & Executive Presentations — Prepare monthly business review decks, variance analysis, margin analytics, and operational KPIs for senior leadership.

What We Look For

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Business, or related field.
  • 4–7 years of mortgage FP&A, servicing analytics, or portfolio-analysis experience.
  • Strong understanding of MSR economics, delinquency modeling, advance mechanics, and servicing cost structures.
  • Experience with servicing systems such as MSP, Sagent, LoanServ, and data analysis tools such as SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI.
  • Ability to work independently and manage complex workloads with strict deadlines.

 Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (MBA or related).
  • CPA or similar financial certification (preferred).

Salary

  • Compensation Range: $85,360 - $128,040/yr
  • Quarterly 25% bonus target
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs
  • This is the compensation range for the United States, actual compensation may vary based on individual candidate experience, location, or evolving business needs

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care, 401k, and commuter benefits
  • Employer-funded life and disability insurance coverage
  • 11 Observed Holidays & PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing  and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Director of Compensation to establish a comprehensive compensation framework.

This role leads the end-to-end design, implementation, and ongoing governance of Riot's foundational compensation programs, including job architecture, salary structures, executive compensation, and equity, in an environment where limited formal structure currently exists. The Director will build scalable frameworks that support corporate functions, data center operations, and executive leadership. The Director carries direct accountability for executive compensation, equity plan administration, and Board readiness, and is hands-on in the systems and data that bring these programs to life.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Total Rewards & Systems, with close partnership across People Partners, Finance, Legal, and senior leadership.

What you'll do

Compensation Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and ongoing governance of Riot's job architecture, including job families, leveling frameworks, and salary structures across a multi-entity organization
  • Ensure job architecture serves as the foundation for Talent Acquisition hiring workflows and employee career frameworks, with clear leveling criteria that support consistent offers, promotions, and career pathing
  • Partner with senior leaders, executives, and People Partners to develop competitive, equitable, and innovative compensation programs that attract and retain top talent
  • Establish market pricing methodology, choose and manage survey sources, and benchmark roles from hourly site technicians to corporate leadership
  • Create compensation guidelines, governance, and decision rules that promote consistency while supporting business agility

Executive Compensation and Board Readiness

  • Own preparation of all Compensation Committee materials and recommendations, including executive compensation analyses, equity plan proposals, and performance metrics aligned with business objectives and governance requirements
  • Provide expert guidance to the Board and the SVP, People Operations on compensation matters
  • Own executive compensation modeling, including peer group review, competitive benchmarking, pay-for-performance analysis, and award scenario modeling
  • Design, implement, and directly administer short- and long-term incentive programs, including equity compensation plans (restricted stock units and performance shares) that align employee interests with company success
  • Own compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and reporting requirements across all total rewards programs, including equity plan administration and compensation-related SEC disclosures such as the proxy statement Compensation Discussion and Analysis, in partnership with Legal and Finance

Compensation Planning, Analytics, and Operations

  • Manage key components of the annual compensation planning cycle, including merit, bonus, and equity refresh
  • Leverage compensation analytics, market intelligence, and AI to inform strategy, improve outcomes, and anticipate changing workforce needs
  • Strengthen compensation operations through scalable processes, governance frameworks, and data-informed decision tools
  • Conduct pay equity reviews and support compliance with state pay transparency and equal pay requirements
  • Advise leaders and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention, and one-off compensation decisions

Systems and Workflow Integration

  • Serve as the hands-on owner of compensation data in Rippling and Riot's new HCM platform, building data models and configuring job, structure, and range data directly
  • Lead the operational integration of annual compensation cycles across systems and payroll, ensuring clean data inputs and seamless handoffs from planning through payroll execution
  • Partner with HRIS, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition to align compensation data, workflows, and controls across platforms

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, with at least 3–5 years supporting executive compensation at a publicly traded company
  • 7+ years leading total rewards or compensation programs or teams
  • Proven ability to build and scale total rewards programs and operations, including job architecture, salary structures, and leveling frameworks
  • Experience preparing materials and presentations for Board Committees
  • Advanced Excel modeling skills and the ability to develop analyses from incomplete or unstructured data
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling and compensation configuration in HRIS/HCM platforms, including integration with payroll
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, independently defining priorities and driving recommendations to completion
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to various audiences 
  • Ability to serve as a high-impact individual contributor, with interest in building and leading a team as the function grows
  • Experience in energy, data centers, manufacturing, crypto, or other environments with a large hourly or shift-based workforce
  • Experience with multi-entity organizations, M&A integration, or harmonizing pay across acquired companies

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCP, CECP, or similar certification
  • Experience with Rippling

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

xStocks brings real-world assets on-chain as tokenized securities that are regulated, fully-backed, and tradable across multiple blockchains. Built within Payward, the xStocks team runs the infrastructure that issues, custodies, and settles these instruments across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, and more. The platform moves real value, so security is not a feature bolted on at the end. It is a property of everything the team ships. This is a hybrid engineering and security seat built for someone who is genuinely both: you ship products alongside the engineering team when the security queue is quiet, and you own security work end to end when it lands. You report into engineering and partner closely with the Payward security, CISO, and compliance functions.

The opportunity

  • Own security deliverables end to end. Coordinate and review smart-contract audits, respond to security questionnaires and due-diligence requests, support CISO and compliance initiatives, and turn findings into tracked, closed-out fixes.

  • Run offensive assessments against our own platforms. Pentest the web apps, APIs, backend services, and on-chain components, and build the tooling to do it repeatedly rather than once.

  • Continuously assess posture. Threat-model new and existing systems, review architecture and key-management flows, and maintain a living view of the risks and their mitigations.

  • Review code for security. Be a default reviewer on changes touching auth, cryptography, custody, signing, and fund movement across our chains.

  • Harden the platform. Improve secrets handling, IAM and least-privilege, dependency and supply-chain hygiene, and detection and logging for security-relevant events.

  • Secure custody and signing workflows. Review and harden transaction signing flows, MPC and HSM integrations, signer permissions, admin roles, approval policies, and break-glass procedures.

  • Contribute to product engineering. Pick up regular backlog work in TypeScript so you stay close to the codebase you are defending.

  • Support incidents. Help with detection, triage, response, and post-mortems, and feed the lessons back into the program.

What you bring

  • An engineer first. You write and review production code comfortably, TypeScript and Node.js in our stack, and you understand systems deeply enough to break them.

  • Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals. The OWASP-class vulnerability landscape, authn and authz, injection, SSRF, supply-chain risk, and secure design. You have done real offensive work in pentesting, vuln research, or red-team.

  • Applied cryptography and blockchain security. Symmetric and asymmetric primitives, hashing, signatures, and key management, plus the security model of EVM, Solana, and ideally TON or Tron. You can read a smart contract and reason about how it fails.

  • Ownership. You can take an ambiguous security item, an audit, a questionnaire, or an incident, and drive it to closure without being managed through it.

  • Clear communication. You can explain a risk to engineers, to a CISO, and to an auditor, and tailor the message to each.

  • An automation instinct. You do not want to catch the same issue manually twice, so you turn findings into tests, alerts, controls, documentation, or platform improvements.

  • Risk judgment. You can tell a theoretical issue from a material one, and communicate severity, likelihood, impact, and remediation tradeoffs clearly.

Nice to have

  • Experience commissioning or remediating third-party smart-contract audits.

  • Familiarity with custody and signing infrastructure such as HSMs, MPC, and ForDefi-style providers, and with on-chain transaction security.

  • Cloud security depth in GCP or AWS, IAM, and container and runtime hardening.

  • Detection engineering and security observability, including SIEM and log-based detections.

  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or GWAPT.

  • Prior work in a regulated fintech or tokenization/DeFi environment.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts.

The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling.

You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed.

Responsibilities

Leadership and planning

  • Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work.
  • Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress.
  • Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting.

Secure design and delivery

  • Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks.
  • Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews.
  • Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing.
  • Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings.
  • Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products.
  • Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings.
  • Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme.

Vulnerability management and external testing

  • Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks.
  • Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure.

Assurance and incident support

  • Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence.
  • Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support.

Qualifications

Required:

  • At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people.
  • Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them.
  • Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management.
  • Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings.
  • Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD.
  • Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers.
  • Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits.
  • A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line.
  • Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives.

Preferred:

  • Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions.
  • Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications.
  • Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications.
  • Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography.
  • Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns.
  • Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

You will join our global Web3 growth and ecosystem team and support the global growth and ecosystem development of broader Web3 initiatives.
This is a global role working closely with cross-functional teams across multiple markets and regions to identify opportunities.
Responsibilities will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

This is a global Web3 growth and ecosystem role, based in Hong Kong and operating across markets. We are looking for a globally minded operations professional who is deeply involved in the on-chain ecosystem, understands diverse on-chain user communities, and can independently plan and execute campaigns across regions.
 
You will work around X Layer and OKX Wallet to connect ecosystem projects, communities, and users worldwide; bring high-quality applications to real users; and turn campaign participation into sustained on-chain usage and ecosystem growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Ecosystem Research and Opportunity Identification: Continuously track leading public blockchains and sectors such as DeFi, on-chain trading, and consumer applications across global markets. Identify projects with product value, an established user base, and growth potential, and develop actionable partnership and operational plans.
